purpose: Source and rights receipts for the self-contained Legion ios-development and macos-development bundles.
composition: Original Legion guidance with substantive MIT- and Apache-adapted rules, decision branches, and examples. Exact upstream notices for retained adaptations are bundled under references/licenses; this file is provenance, not executable permission.
packaging: Each bundle includes its own references, local license notices, source provenance, original read-only PATH preflight helper, and official-source setup recipes; no upstream binaries, installers, credentials, live MCP client configuration, or unmodified source trees are bundled.
permissionBoundary: Skill availability does not authorize installation, network services, telemetry, credential or security changes, simulator erasure, device access, dependency additions, signing identity changes, uploading, notarization submissions, or release/publishing.
